summary: Iteration 17 — Zoom Meeting SDK live-class E2E regression on Supabase Postgres. 20/20 new pytest cases pass in /app/backend/tests/test_zoom_live_classes.py covering: teacher create (zoom_meeting_id/password/join_url returned; zoom_start_url NOT leaked; 400 for empty batches / bad date; 403 for student), teacher start (SDK signature + sdk_key + meeting_number returned; zak best-effort; non-owner teacher 403; owner + admin allowed; 404 bogus id), student list (batch-scoped, cancelled excluded), student join (403 foreign batch, 400 not-live, 200 signature after start), raise-hand (idempotent — 2 calls => 1 row, appears in teacher participants under raised_hands with is_live=true), teacher lower-hand (removes row), end class (is_live=false, status=completed, raised_hands cleared), delete class (non-owner teacher 403, owner allowed, admin bypass allowed, subsequent GET returns 404). Regression: iter16 payments+analytics suite 18/18 still green. Real Zoom S2S OAuth create_meeting / delete_meeting / get_host_zak / dashboard participants API round-trips succeeded (zak returned, participants empty which is acceptable — no live browser).
critical_code_review_comments: student_live_class_routes.raise_hand: guards batch membership but does NOT require is_live=true. A student can raise hand on an upcoming (not yet started) class that's in their batch, and the row will sit until teacher starts+ends. Low-severity, but consider adding 'AND is_live=true' check for correctness.
student_live_class_routes.lower_hand: no 404 if class_id doesn't exist (silent DELETE 0 rows). Harmless but inconsistent with other endpoints.

teacher_live_class_routes.create_live_class: accepts any ISO date, including PAST dates. Zoom API may still accept them but business-wise you probably want scheduled_dt > now(). Not tested here, but a code-review flag.

teacher_live_class_routes.start_live_class: `cls.get('zoom_meeting_password', '')` — asyncpg Records don't support .get(); this would raise AttributeError if the branch is ever hit. Works today only because zoom_meeting_password is always present. Same pattern on line 126 (`cls.get('zoom_start_url', '')`). Convert to `cls['zoom_meeting_password']` or dict-cast first.
teacher_live_class_routes.create_live_class: bare `except Exception` around notify_students_about_class swallows errors silently — add logger.exception for observability.
student_live_class_routes.list_live_classes: no pagination — will scale poorly once classes grow. Add LIMIT/OFFSET later.
